parsed.explanation: Worst exposure is tier-1 universal facility exclusion: the 2025 law reserves public multi-occupancy restrooms, changing areas and sleeping quarters by biological sex, with a private cause of action for encountering an opposite-sex person, and no state public-accommodations protection to remedy exclusion (only 3 city ordinances). That applies to every visitor needing public facilities, analogous to the 0.45 bathroom-ban anchor, not merely social friction. It is pulled down by the shared national regime: X/mismatched passport processing stopped, existing X valid, and visa guidance to refuse on document discrepancy casting doubt on sex, with possible permanent fraud consideration, plus birth-sex sleeping quarters and documented national custody harms if detained. No trans-presentation offence, organised police targeting, extortion, or documented ward/custody abuse pattern for this division is shown, private facilities are not banned, and national hate-crime recourse exists, keeping it above the 0.35 unremedied ward/search/extortion profiles.
